Meet them there, make reordering quick: A marketplace is a good way to meet an account you had no route to. Once they buy from you regularly, some will want a quicker way to reorder than logging in, and our app gives them one while the listing keeps working.
Let each account order the way it likes: Kitchens happy ordering through BlueCart can keep doing it. Regulars who would still rather call get an app that turns what they say into a list they check.

@graph.name: Is a BlueCart alternative the only way to add spoken orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, and the listing never has to come down. VoiceOrder Solutions adds an app where the accounts on your books say what they need and approve it, while BlueCart goes on bringing in kitchens that are new to you. Nothing gets turned off.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than BlueCart?

acceptedAnswer.text: At finding new customers, no, and it is not a close call. That is their product and we do not have one. We help with the repeat order from an account already on your books: your range only, your prices, approved by the buyer. People who search for a BlueCart alternative are often after that second job, not a way out of the first.

@graph.name: Are VoiceOrder Solutions and BlueCart connected?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The two products are not linked, and neither supports the other. Each delivers its orders into your own system independently, ours as an email with a file attached, over EDI or the API, or into QuickBooks.

@graph.name: Won't our accounts be ordering in two places?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some may, and that can be fine. A kitchen you met on the marketplace can keep buying there. Offer our app to the regulars who still call your desk, since a spoken reorder from your own guide is where it saves the most time. Calls you go on taking get no order number from us; that only comes with orders sent through the app.

@graph.name: How do our prices appear in your app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each account sees its own guide, priced the way you set it. BlueCart's Pricing Insights, which labels products as great, good or fair value, carries on for your marketplace listing.

@graph.name: How fast can accounts begin ordering?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most distributors this is live inside 24 to 48 hours, with a first order usually in on the same day. BlueCart says theirs can be live within days too, and since the listing stays up, there is nothing to time around.
Neither of us publishes a figure. Theirs follows a demo; ours comes as a quote once we have talked. With the listing kept, the only new cost is the voice reorder, and a quote shows what that is.

@graph.name: Where do the BlueCart details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Everything here came from bluecart.com, read 10 October 2026: the marketplace positioning off the headline, the Pricing Insights and endless aisle descriptions off their product list, and the setup line off their FAQ. We have left their transaction and funding figures alone, because those are theirs. If any of it has moved on, the fault is here, not there.
